schema_note: No ratified schema exists in this repository. Keys below are limited to what verification/locales/README.md names explicitly (case data in locale_cases/<locale>.json; the nine emitted checks; --check-env, --dry-run, --headless, --out-dir, --write-markdown, --save-page-source, --driver-path; exit codes 0/1/2), plus one optional key: untranslated_probe, a list of English label strings that must not render. Corrected 2026-09-29: the harness that consumes this file is now written and committed (verification/locales/verify_locale_stream.py), and a sibling case file now exists (locale_cases/it_IT.json, also draft-unratified). Nothing in this file becomes a result: everything a run would produce is still null.
untranslated_probe_note: Empty on purpose. Until an English label list is supplied, no_untranslated_fallback is SKIP, never PASS.

target.device_class: OPNsense firewall admin UI (outside this repository)
target.address_provenance: operator-attested 2026-09-28; supplied as the same host as the it_IT testbed
target.address_note: The supplied fr_FR log transcript names no address, route, or build. This value is an operator statement and is not a verified fact; it closes nothing and must be corrected if an artifact shows a different host.

checks_note: null means not exercised by or attributable to this workstream. It never means PASS.

markers.mapped_check_note: Neither marker maps to a check name emitted by the verification/locales harness.

teardown.note: A firewall locale change is infrastructure state, not a documentation fact. Confirming the restore needs the device's own state, which is not in this repository.

harness.status_note: Corrected 2026-09-29: the script is written and committed (harness version 0.1.0) and passes its offline self-test. It is still not runnable on the recording host, and it has never been run for fr_FR: harness_executed stays false and every checks value stays null.
blocked_by: selenium is not importable on the recording host
no browser or WebDriver binary installed

exit_codes.1: at least one FAIL or ERROR

rules: Case data carries boundaries and provenance only. No field may hold a value that no artifact supports; unsupported values are null.
A reported result with no artifact stays PENDING-EVIDENCE. It never becomes PASS or RESOLVED.
Run output belongs in out/<locale>/ and must be the tool's own output, never a transcription.
Closing a locale item requires the acceptance checklist in verification/locales/out/README.md.
A locale change on a firewall is infrastructure state. Record the device build and its before/after locale state.
Operator attestation is recorded as attestation, with its provenance stated, and is never promoted to verified fact.
